scenarios.name: Delete a todo item
scenarios.reason:
Added “Buy milk” to the todo list by entering it in the todo field and submitting it.
Confirmed that “Buy milk” appeared in the todo list.
Deleted “Buy milk” using its Delete button.
Confirmed that “Buy milk” was no longer visible in the todo list.

steps.remark: type: Typing Buy milk into the todo field
analyze: Buy milk is visible in the todo list.
assert: Buy milk is visible in the todo list.
click: Clicking Delete for Buy milk
analyze: Buy milk is no longer visible in the todo list.
assert: Buy milk is no longer visible in the todo list.
